info.title: AGR — Agentic Governance Runtime
info.description:
Drop-in governance layer for AI agent frameworks. Every agent tool call is evaluated against Cedar policies before execution. Sensitive actions require human approval.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/v1/health`) require `Authorization: Bearer agr_sk_<key>` header.

## Decision Values

- `ALLOW` — agent may proceed
- `DENY` — action is blocked
- `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` — action is queued for human approval

get.description: Liveness probe — returns 200 if the process is running.

Readiness probe — verifies DB, Redis, and Cedar CLI availability.

Returns 200 {"status": "ok", "checks": {...}} if all critical deps are healthy.
Returns 503 {"status": "degraded", "checks": {...}} if any critical check fails.
Cedar CLI absence is advisory — it degrades gracefully to Python fallback.

Prometheus-format metrics endpoint.

Exposes:
  agr_evaluations_total        — by decision label
  agr_risk_score               — histogram (0–100 buckets)
  agr_approval_decisions_total — by decision label
  agr_policy_changes_total     — by operation label
  agr_webhook_deliveries_total — by status label

schema.title: Response List Policies V1 Policies Get

post.description:
Bulk import policies from a JSON list.

Set dry_run=true to validate without writing.
Set overwrite=true to update existing policies with matching names.

get.description: Export all org policies as a JSON array suitable for re-import.

post.description:
Simulate a policy decision without any side effects.

Runs the full Cedar evaluation + risk scoring pipeline against the org's
active policies but writes nothing — no audit event, no approval row,
no cache entry, no eval_count increment.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a policy by archiving it (state=archived, active=False).

M3: audit_events.policy_id holds historical references to policies;
hard-deleting would leave stale foreign keys in the immutable audit trail.
Archiving preserves the row (and audit integrity) while stopping the
policy from being evaluated in future requests.

patch.description:
Transition a draft or archived policy to active state.

Only active policies are evaluated by the Cedar engine.

Archive a policy, removing it from evaluation without hard-deleting it.

Archived policies preserve the audit trail FK integrity and can be
inspected but not evaluated or updated.

get.description:
Return the full version history for a policy, newest first.

Each entry is a snapshot taken immediately before a content-changing PATCH.
The live policy state is not included — fetch GET /v1/policies/{id} for that.

schema.title: Response List Policy Versions V1 Policies  Policy Id  Versions Get

post.description:
Restore a policy to a previous version snapshot.

The current state is snapshotted before the restore so the rollback itself
is reversible. The policy version counter is incremented to indicate a new
change event.

schema.title: Response List Approvals V1 Approvals Get

get.description: Render a confirmation page for one-click email approve/reject links.

post.description: Execute one-click approve/reject from email link (no auth required).

Re-send approval email to a (new) approver email address.

Updates approver_email and resends the notification. Returns 409 if
the approval is no longer pending.
Increments token_version so old email links sent to the previous
approver are immediately invalidated (H3).

get.description: List all approver steps for this approval request.

schema.title: Response List Approval Steps V1 Approvals  Approval Id  Steps Get

post.description: Add an approver step to a pending approval request.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events V1 Audit Get

post.description:
POST-body alternative to GET /audit for complex filter combinations.

Useful when query-string length is a concern or when building structured
search UIs that prefer sending JSON.

schema.title: Response Search Audit Events V1 Audit Search Post

post.description:
Stream audit events matching filters as a CSV file.

Streams rows in pages of 1 000 to avoid loading the full result set into
memory. Caps at 50 000 rows; use offset/pagination for larger exports.

get.description:
Re-compute and verify the SHA-256 hash chain for this org's audit log.

Walks events in sequence order in pages of 1 000 rows to prevent OOM on
large audit logs. Stops at `limit` events (default/max = 100 000).
Returns the first invalid sequence number if a break is found.

post.description:
Register or update an agent for this org.

Upserts on (org_id, agent_id) — registering the same agent_id again
updates its profile fields and metadata.

patch.description: Update an agent's profile fields or active status.

get.description: List all registered agents for this org.

schema.title: Response List Agents V1 Agents Get

get.summary: Get Api Key From Clerk Session
get.description:
Exchange a Clerk session JWT for the org's AGR API key.

The dashboard calls this after login to auto-populate the API key,
eliminating the need to manually paste it in Settings.

Requires CLERK_SECRET_KEY to be configured. Returns 401 if the
Clerk session is invalid or the org does not exist yet.

post.description:
Handle Clerk webhook events.

Verifies the Svix signature (skipped in dev when clerk_webhook_secret is empty).
Creates org + seeds default policies on user.created.
Idempotent: duplicate user_id returns 200 without creating a second row.

schema.title: Response List Webhooks V1 Webhooks Get

post.description: Register a webhook URL. The secret is shown once — store it securely.

patch.description: Update a webhook's URL, subscribed events, or active status.

get.description: List the last 50 delivery attempts for a webhook (newest first).

schema.title: Response List Deliveries V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Deliveries Get

post.description: Manually retry a failed webhook delivery. Creates a new delivery record.

Generate a new HMAC secret for a webhook. Old secret is immediately invalid.

The new secret is shown once — update your receiver to verify with it.

Send a test ping delivery to a webhook URL to verify connectivity.

Creates a delivery record with event type 'webhook.test'.
Uses a synchronous HTTP POST (no retry) — returns the raw HTTP status.

get.description: Return the authenticated org's profile and usage stats.

schema.title: Response List Conversations V1 Copilot Conversations Get

get.description: Return current risk scoring config; creates default if not yet customised.

put.description:
Update risk scoring weights/thresholds for this org.

Weights must sum to ≤ 1.0 after update (advisory — engine normalises anyway).
threshold_allow_max must be < threshold_approval_max.

get.description:
Return an aggregated compliance posture for the last N days.

Computes:
- Total evaluation count and decision breakdown
- High-risk event count (payload.risk_level == "high")
- Compliance findings aggregated from stored payload data

Compliance findings are stored in audit event payloads during /evaluate.
This endpoint aggregates them across recent events.

Export a compliance posture report for the requested period. **Admin role required.** Supported formats: `json` (default), `csv`, and `pdf` (falls back to JSON when PDF rendering is unavailable). The JSON export includes org info, risk summary, audit trail summary, policy violations, per-standard pass/fail counts, and a row per compliance finding.
Returns all members of the authenticated organization, including invited, active, and revoked members.

schema.title: Response List Members V1 Org Members Get

post.description: Sends an invite to the given email address. Requires admin role. An audit event (MEMBER_INVITED) is written for every invite.

patch.description: Changes the role of an existing member. Requires admin role. An audit event (MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED) is written.

delete.description: Revokes the member's access (sets status to 'revoked'). Does not delete the row — the member remains in the audit history. Requires admin role.

workflow_mode.title: Workflow Mode
workflow_mode.description: Workflow tracking mode: 'temporal' when a durable Temporal workflow was started; 'db_only' when Temporal is not configured.

workflow_status.title: Workflow Status
workflow_status.description: Current durable workflow state for the approval lifecycle.

workflow_last_error.title: Workflow Last Error
workflow_last_error.description: Most recent workflow execution or signaling error, when present.

workflow_last_transition_at.title: Workflow Last Transition At
workflow_last_transition_at.description: Timestamp of the last workflow status transition.

workflow_fallback_mode.title: Workflow Fallback Mode
workflow_fallback_mode.description: Explicit fallback state. 'none' means normal Temporal tracking or no fallback was needed; other values explain why the approval is operating in a degraded mode.

workflow_escalated_at.title: Workflow Escalated At
workflow_escalated_at.description: Timestamp of the latest escalation event, if the workflow was escalated.

AuditSearchRequest.title: AuditSearchRequest
AuditSearchRequest.description: POST body for /v1/audit/search — structured filter query.

remediation_steps.title: Remediation Steps
remediation_steps.description: Deterministic remediation guidance derived from the violated control and risk signals.

severity_level.title: Severity Level
severity_level.description: Normalized severity level derived from the finding and request risk factors.

compliance_score.title: Compliance Score
compliance_score.description: Deterministic compliance score for this finding. Higher is better.

compliance_score.title: Compliance Score
compliance_score.description: Aggregate compliance score across sampled findings.

policy_source.title: Policy Source
policy_source.description: Policy engine that produced the decision. 'cedar_cli' = authoritative Cedar binary; 'python_fallback' = regex approximation (dev/degraded mode); 'no_policies' = no active policies found; 'cache' = served from Redis cache.

cedar_decision.title: Cedar Decision
cedar_decision.description: Raw policy engine decision before risk scoring could override it.

risk_override.title: Risk Override
risk_override.description: True when risk scoring upgraded the Cedar ALLOW to APPROVAL_REQUIRED or DENY.

fallback_used.title: Fallback Used
fallback_used.description: True when the Python regex fallback was used instead of Cedar CLI. Fallback results may differ from Cedar in edge cases — install cedar-policy-cli for authoritative enforcement.

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Machine-readable reason Cedar CLI was not used (populated when fallback_used=true).

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent making the request.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action the agent wants to perform (maps to Cedar Action entity).

context.title: Context
context.description: Arbitrary context key/values evaluated in Cedar when clauses. Max 50 keys.

approver_email.title: Approver Email
approver_email.description: Override approver email for this specific request.

policy_id.title: Policy Id
policy_id.description: UUID of the matching Cedar policy.

approval_id.title: Approval Id
approval_id.description: UUID of the created approval (APPROVAL_REQUIRED only).

eval_id.title: Eval Id
eval_id.description: Unique evaluation identifier for audit lookup.

risk_factors.title: Risk Factors
risk_factors.description: Per-factor risk contributions. Keys: action_severity, data_sensitivity, agent_trust, context_risk, time_risk.

compliance_findings.title: Compliance Findings
compliance_findings.description: Advisory compliance findings (EU AI Act, SOC2, ISO42001).

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

role.title: Role
role.description: Role to assign: admin | operator | viewer
